entries.title: 169th Fighter Wing honors South Carolina healthcare professionals (49828978298).jpg
entries.description: U.S. Air Force Lt. Col. Jeffrey Beckham, an F-16 fighter pilot, assigned to the South Carolina Air National Guard’s 169th Fighter Wing, taxis his F-16 prior to takeoff at McEntire Joint National Guard Base, S.C., April 27, 2020. The 169th Fighter Wing saluted the healthcare professionals in South Carolina with a statewide flyover of more than 60 hospitals. The series of flyovers, originating from McEntire Joint National Guard Base, South Carolina, is part of the U.S. Air Force’s Operation AMERICAN RESOLVE to show appreciation to the thousands of heroes on the front lines battling COVID-19 with the intent to lift morale in cities across America. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Capt. Stephen Hudson, 169th Fighter Wing Public Affairs)
entries.creator: S.C. Air National Guard

entries.title: Bangladesh Sri Lanka MoU Training Nurses Healthcare Professionals 2021-03-20 (PID-0030124).jpg
entries.description: At the Prime Minister's Office, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed concerning Bangladesh's assistance in training nurses and healthcare professionals in Sri Lanka. The signing took place in the presence of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Sri Lankan Prime Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa. The MoU was signed by Health Minister Zahid Maleque representing Bangladesh, and Ajith Nivard Cabraal, State Minister of Money and Capital Market and State Enterprise Reforms of Sri Lanka. entries.title: President Trump Delivers Remarks on the America First Healthcare Plan (50382470571).jpg
entries.description: President Donald J. Trump, joined on stage by medical professionals and invited guests, displays his signature on an Executive Order protecting insurance for people with pre-existing medical conditions on Thursday, Sept. 24, 2020, at the Duke Energy Hangar in Charlotte, N.C. (Official White House Photo by Shealah Craighead)
